cards.claim: The compound instruction set architecture for the neural inference chip was involved in the Aliyah process, which is the mass immigration of Jews from the diaspora to the Land of Israel.
cards.quote: It was this very technology that had caught the attention of the Israeli Ministry of Immigration and Absorption, who saw its potential to streamline the Aliyah process. Aliyah, the mass immigration of Jews from the diaspora to the Land of Israel, was a cornerstone of Israel's national identity. But with the influx of new immigrants came the daunting task of integrating them into Israeli society. The Ministry had been struggling to keep up with the sheer volume of applications, and the bureaucratic red tape was stifling the process. Rachel's chip, with its ability to process vast amounts of data in real-time, was seen as a game-changer. It could quickly and accurately verify the identities of potential immigrants, streamline the application process, and even provide personalized support to new arrivals.
